data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order with the right parameters (person, domain as site, year), but it adds a spurious snapshot_day parameter, leaves out the tab switching, and is vague on the Notes steps (clicking "New note", the note format, pressing Enter), the birth date and position details, and how to pick the calendar day, so it could only be partly automated from the spec alone.
